title: Sara Sofía Abril Guevara
text: With an interdisciplinary background in statistics, electronic engineering, and biology, I develop analytical and computational solutions for complex challenges in energy, science, and technology.

title: Sara Sofía Abril Guevara
text:
I am an interdisciplinary researcher with a background in electronic engineering, biology, and statistics.
My work lies at the intersection of statistical modeling, computational science, energy systems, and environmental research.
I hold an M.S. in Statistics from the University of California, Davis, and degrees in Electronic Engineering and Biology from the National University of Colombia.
